item.title: Leaving to Succeed: A Filipino Nurse’s Journey in the United States
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – Leaving home is often framed as ambition, but for many Filipino nurses, it is an act of survival born from a system that trains excellence yet struggles to keep it. item.title: Once lived in a cemetery for 21 years, now a successful teacher in America
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – The story of Hapibel Duque begins in a place where life is often overlooked, as she spent 21 years living inside a cemetery in Pasay, an environment that shaped both her resilience and her unyielding belief in possibility. Hapibel Duque, former working student who lived in a cemetery for 21 years, now recognized as Outstanding Global Educator. Photo courtesy: Hapibel Duque
